name: Jarvis
changes_cs: Jarvis u Ollama modelových dotazů posílá keep_alive 0, takže se router i hlavní model po dokončení odpovědi uvolní z RAM/VRAM a nezůstávají zbytečně nahrané po práci.
changes_en: Jarvis now sends keep_alive 0 for Ollama model requests, so both the router model and the main response model are released from RAM/VRAM after the answer instead of staying loaded after work.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis u Ollama modelových dotazů posílá keep_alive 0, takže se router i hlavní model po dokončení odpovědi uvolní z RAM/VRAM a nezůstávají zbytečně nahrané po práci.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now sends keep_alive 0 for Ollama model requests, so both the router model and the main response model are released from RAM/VRAM after the answer instead of staying loaded after work.

history.changes_cs: Přidává veřejně bezpečné Jeniksoft dovednosti pro CPM, nativní Windows aplikace, Planetopii a Strategic Nexus. Dovednosti se balí do instalace, zapnou se v nových i starších konfiguracích a soukromá pravidla čtou až z lokálního projektu.
history.changes_en: Adds public-safe Jeniksoft skills for CPM, native Windows apps, Planetopia, and Strategic Nexus. The skills are bundled into setup, enabled for new and upgraded configs, and read private rules only from the local project checkout.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis doplnil dovednost Světotvorba a World Bible, lépe rozpoznává dlouhé autorské lore jako kánon nebo draft, zpřesňuje projektový intake, doplňuje lokalizované popisy dovednosti a zobrazuje srozumitelnější chyby pro obrázky a vision modely.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now bundles a Worldbuilding and World Bible skill, treats long lore as author-provided canon or draft, improves creative project intake, adds localized skill labels, and shows clearer image and vision model failure messages.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis doplnil dovednost Světotvorba a World Bible, lépe rozpoznává dlouhé autorské lore jako kánon nebo draft, zpřesňuje projektový intake a zobrazuje srozumitelnější chyby pro obrázky a vision modely.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now bundles a Worldbuilding and World Bible skill, treats long lore as author-provided canon or draft, improves creative project intake, and shows clearer image and vision model failure messages.

history.changes_cs: Kopirovani celeho chatu ted vklada do schranky citelne bloky Uživatel/Jarvis a ponechava prilohy pod zpravou, ke ktere patri.
history.changes_en: Copying the whole chat now places readable User/Jarvis blocks on the clipboard and keeps attachments listed under the message they belong to.

history.changes_cs: Opraveno ukonceni Jarvise z menu Aplikace. Volba Ukoncit uz neskonci v rekurzivnim WM_CLOSE cyklu a necha okno skutecne zaniknout, zatimco zavreni okna muze dal schovat aplikaci do tray.
history.changes_en: Fixed exiting Jarvis from the Application menu. Exit no longer falls into a recursive WM_CLOSE loop and now lets the window actually close, while the window close button can still hide the app to the tray.

history.changes_cs: Chat ma novou ikonu pro zkopirovani cele konverzace. Jednim kliknutim se do schranky zkopiruji vsechny dotazy a odpovedi, aby slo chovani Jarvise snadno poslat k analyze.
history.changes_en: The chat now has a new copy-whole-conversation icon. One click copies all prompts and replies to the clipboard so Jarvis behavior can be shared for analysis.

history.changes_cs: Update ikona Jarvise je presunuta z horniho zahlavi do leveho spodniho panelu a je vetsi, aby byla citelnejsi. Zahlavi zustava volnejsi a pouziva se jen pro docasne stavove ikony.
history.changes_en: Jarvis update icon moved from the top header to the lower-left panel and is larger for better readability. The header stays cleaner and is used only for temporary status icons.

history.changes_cs: Projektovy start Jarvise ted dela i zhodnoceni a klikaci navrhy dalsich kroku. Klik na navrh ho zaradi jako beznou zpravu v chatu, bez zahozeni rozepsaneho vstupu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis project start now includes assessment and clickable next-step suggestions. Clicking a suggestion queues it as a normal chat message without discarding the current draft.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis byl znovu sestaven po aktualizaci WDUi skinu, aby instalator a verejny updater dorucily aktualni vzhled.
history.changes_en: Jarvis was rebuilt after WDUi skin updates so the installer and public updater deliver the current visual styling.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis byl znovu sestaven jako instalovatelny setup pro verejnou aktualizaci. Pravidla Jarvise ted vyslovne rikaji, ze update-ready build musi pouzit setup publish cestu do ADPU.
history.changes_en: Jarvis was rebuilt as an installable setup for public updates. Jarvis rules now explicitly require the setup publish path to ADPU for update-ready builds.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pouziva novy WDUi tint bitmap obrazek pro tlacitko Pridat, takze se akce prebarvuje podle skinu misto starsich pevnych bitmap.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now uses the new WDUi tint bitmap asset for the Add button, so the action recolors with the active skin instead of using the older fixed bitmap states.

history.changes_cs: Stahovani modelu z knihovny bezi asynchronne mimo chat. Dialog ukazuje prubeh, stazeno/celkem a rychlost v bajtech za sekundu; lze ho schovat do ikonky v zahlavi, kde zustava aktualni stav.
history.changes_en: Model downloads from the library now run asynchronously outside chat. The dialog shows progress, downloaded/total bytes and bytes-per-second speed; it can be hidden to a title-bar icon that keeps the current status.

history.changes_cs: Stahovani modelu z knihovny bezi asynchronne mimo chat. Dialog ukazuje prubeh, stazeno/celkem a rychlost v bajtech za sekundu a lze ho schovat do ikonky v zahlavi.
history.changes_en: Model downloads from the library now run asynchronously outside chat. The progress dialog shows progress, downloaded/total bytes and bytes-per-second speed, and can be hidden to a title-bar icon.

history.changes_cs: Archivovane chaty maji citelny samostatny nadpis a Codex-style obrazovku: vyhledavani, filtr podle projektu, skupiny projektu, obnova a mazani bez stare technicke Spravy chatu.
history.changes_en: Archived chats now have a clear dedicated title and Codex-style view: search, project filtering, project groups, restore, and delete without the old technical chat management screen.

history.changes_cs: Archivovane chaty maji samostatnou obrazovku ve stylu Codexu: vyhledavani, filtr podle projektu, skupiny projektu, obnova a mazani bez stare technicke Spravy chatu.
history.changes_en: Archived chats now have a dedicated Codex-style view: search, project filtering, project groups, restore, and delete without the old technical chat management screen.

history.changes_cs: Popup chatu v levem panelu je zjednoduseny: duplicitni akce Nacist chat, Bez projektu a Sprava chatu jsou pryc, prirazeni k projektu umi i bez projektu a sirka popupu se prizpusobuje nejdelsi akci.
history.changes_en: The left-sidebar chat popup is simplified: duplicate Load chat, No project, and Chat management actions are gone, Assign to project also covers no-project assignment, and popup width follows the longest action label.

history.changes_cs: Chaty v levem seznamu jsou pod projekty skutecne odsazene zleva, aby projektovy panel pusobil hierarchicky jako strom.
history.changes_en: Chats in the left sidebar are now truly indented under projects so the project panel reads as a hierarchy.

history.changes_cs: Spodni okraj hlavniho okna Jarvise je zmenseny: nova layout verze normalizuje ulozene okno na kompaktnejsi vysku a zachova maximalizovany stav.
history.changes_en: Jarvis main window bottom margin is reduced: a new layout version normalizes the saved window to a more compact height while preserving maximized state.

history.changes_cs: Spodni chatovy layout Jarvise uz nerezervuje prazdny prostor pro skrytou frontu; konverzace se natahne dolu a progressbar je tesne nad vstupem.
history.changes_en: Jarvis chat layout no longer reserves empty space for the hidden queue; the conversation expands downward and the progress bar sits close to the input.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pri chatu prirazeneho ke konkretnimu projektu automaticky pripoji omezeny read-only projektovy kontext, aby se s projektem orientacne seznamil bez rucniho prikazu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now automatically adds bounded read-only project context for chats assigned to a concrete project, so it can orient itself without a manual load-project request.

history.changes_cs: Akce projektu Soubory, Slozka a Smazat jsou presunute do popup menu na prave tlacitko nad projektem; levy panel uz nema duplicitni projektova tlacitka.
history.changes_en: Project actions Files, Folder, and Delete moved into the project right-click popup; the left sidebar no longer shows duplicate project buttons.

history.changes_cs: Tray popup Jarvise se vraci na stejny vzor jako Restart Guard: zavira se pres normalni WM_ACTIVATE pri kliknuti mimo nej a uz nema agresivni timer/foreground watchdog, ktery popup hned zaviral.
history.changes_en: Jarvis tray popup now follows the same pattern as Restart Guard: it closes through normal WM_ACTIVATE when clicking outside and no longer uses the aggressive timer/foreground watchdog that closed it immediately.

history.changes_cs: Tray popup Jarvise se ted zavira spolehlive i pri kliknuti mimo nej mimo beznou focus cestu. Build skript Jarvise a durable WDUi sablona overuji plne Visual Studio developer prostredi a preferuji VS 18, aby linkovani nepadalo na nekompletnim shellu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis tray popup now closes reliably when clicking outside it, even outside the normal focus path. The Jarvis build script and durable WDUi template now require a full Visual Studio developer environment and prefer VS 18 so linking does not fail in a partial shell.

history.changes_cs: Vychozi projekt Jarvise ted pouziva slozku Dokumenty\Jarvis aktualniho uzivatele misto pevne cesty C:\Jarvis.
history.changes_en: Jarvis Default Project now uses the current user Documents\Jarvis folder instead of the fixed C:\Jarvis path.

history.changes_cs: Tray popup a dalsi kratkodobe popupy Jarvise ted pouzivaji WDUi dismiss-on-deactivate, takze se po kliknuti mimo ne zaviraji frameworkovou cestou. Pravidla a sablona doplnuji, ze app handler nesmi spotrebovat WM_ACTIVATE pred WDUi.
history.changes_en: Jarvis tray popup and other short-lived popups now use WDUi dismiss-on-deactivate so clicking outside closes them through the framework path. The rules and template now clarify that app handlers must not consume WM_ACTIVATE before WDUi.

history.changes_cs: Dialogy Jarvise si pamatuji okno nebo dialog, ze ktereho vznikly, a po zavreni vraci fokus zpet tam misto skoku do hlavniho okna.
history.changes_en: Jarvis dialogs now remember the window or dialog they were opened from and return focus there on close instead of jumping to the main window.

history.changes_cs: Pridava interni read-only viewer vzdaleneho GitHub repozitare pro projekty svazane s GitHub remote. V Souborech projektu je nove tlacitko GitHub, ktere nacita vzdaleny strom, slozky a textove nahledy bez otevreni weboveho prohlizece.
history.changes_en: Adds an internal read-only remote GitHub repository viewer for projects linked to a GitHub remote. Project Files now has a GitHub button that loads the remote tree, folders, and text previews without opening a web browser.

history.changes_cs: Vychozi projekt je v seznamu projektu vzdy prvni a nejde odstranit; chaty bez projektu se zobrazuji pod nim a bezne projekty lze odebrat z vyberu. Knihovna modelu zvyraznuje modely prave vybrane pro praci.
history.changes_en: The default project is always first in the project list and cannot be removed; no-project chats are shown under it and regular projects can be removed from a chooser. The model library highlights models currently selected for work.

history.changes_cs: Vychozi projekt je v seznamu projektu vzdy prvni a nejde odstranit; chaty bez projektu se zobrazuji pod nim a bezne projekty lze odebrat z vyberu. Knihovna modelu zvyraznuje modely prave vybrane pro praci.
history.changes_en: The default project is always first in the project list and cannot be removed; no-project chats are shown under it and regular projects can be removed from a chooser. The model library highlights models currently selected for work.

history.changes_cs: Stary prouzek fronty u vstupu byl odstranen. Cekajici zpravy se ted ovladaji primo pres akcni ikonu u konkretni polozky fronty.
history.changes_en: The old input queue strip was removed. Waiting messages are now controlled directly from the action icon on each queue item.

history.changes_cs: Fronta prace v chatu ma u kazde cekajici zpravy akcni ikonu. Popup umozni zpravu poslat hned, upravit ji ve vstupu nebo ji smazat z fronty bez psani prikazu.
history.changes_en: The chat work queue now has an action icon for each waiting message. The popup can send it next, edit it in the input, or delete it from the queue without typing commands.

history.changes_cs: Levy seznam projektu a chatu je citelnejsi: projekty maji ikonku slozky a chaty pod projekty jsou odsazene, aby bylo jasne videt hierarchii.
history.changes_en: The left project/chat list is clearer: projects now show a folder icon and chats under projects are indented to make the hierarchy visible.

history.changes_cs: Tooltipy v Jarvisovi se zobrazuji rychleji: vychozi prodleva byla zkracena z 2500 ms na 1000 ms.
history.changes_en: Jarvis tooltips now appear faster: the default delay was reduced from 2500 ms to 1000 ms.

history.changes_cs: Doplnena lokalizace viditelnych ovladacich prvku v Jarvisovi: pridavani podkladu, modely, projekty, soubory projektu, chatove dialogy, automatizace, update a tray uz nepouzivaji pevne ceske popisky. Lokalizacni pamet byla doplnena pro vsechny podporovane jazyky a build Jarvise pouziva /bigobj pro rozsirenou lokalizacni tabulku.
history.changes_en: Localization was added for visible Jarvis controls: adding context, models, projects, project files, chat dialogs, automation, update, and tray no longer use fixed Czech labels. The localization memory was completed for all supported languages and the Jarvis build now uses /bigobj for the expanded localization table.

history.changes_cs: Dialog Noveho projektu je ted nepruhledny a jde presunout tazenim za horni cast. Vychozi cesta pro nove projekty je C:\Jarvis a Jarvis ji pri vytvareni projektu pripravi, kdyz jeste neexistuje.
history.changes_en: The New Project dialog is now opaque and can be moved by dragging the top area. The default location for new projects is C:\Jarvis, and Jarvis prepares it when creating a project if it does not exist yet.

history.changes_cs: Dialog Schopnosti je ted nepruhledny a jde ho presunout tazenim za horni cast okna.
history.changes_en: The Capabilities dialog is now opaque and can be moved by dragging the top area of the window.

history.changes_cs: Automatizace ma novy prehled ve stylu chatu: seznam aktualni prace, fronta a historie jsou v rolovatelnem okne s tichymi akcemi v radcich.
history.changes_en: Automation now uses a chat-style overview: current work, queue, and recent history are shown in a scrollable window with quiet row actions.

history.changes_cs: Menu a podmenu ve WDUi ted automaticky ukazuji tooltip s plnym textem, kdyz se polozka kvuli skinu nebo sirce nevejde.
history.changes_en: WDUi menus and submenus now automatically show a tooltip with the full text when an item is clipped by the current skin or width.

history.changes_cs: Panel Schopnosti je pohyblivy, ma scroll koleckem i posuvnikem a textove zapinani nahradil skinovatelny switch.
history.changes_en: The Capabilities panel can be moved, uses mouse-wheel and scrollbar scrolling, and replaces text enable buttons with a skin-aware switch.
